summary: Backend-only regression tests for questionnaire resend and Stripe Connect. All 4 tests passed: questionnaire send with email (200, email_sent:true, success:true), idempotent resend (same store, second call also 200), GET /api/stripe-connect/status (200), POST /api/stripe-connect/create-account with return_url/refresh_url returns valid stripe.com URL (200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints confirmed working. Questionnaire resend is idempotent (200 on repeated calls for store fc0bad7e-9040-477e-93b9-a3f0b1a2df90). Stripe Connect status and create-account both return 200 with correct shape. Frontend fix for resend (showResendInput state in WebstoreSetupFlow.js) was not UI-tested in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Questionnaire resend bug was frontend-only: phase-gate condition blocked form from showing when phase='sent'. Fix: added showResendInput state so Resend button bypasses the phase check. Backend was always idempotent. Stripe was already working on backend.
